_comment: SYNCHRONIZATION: Infrastructure Drift Detection and Remediation
_purpose: When AWS Config detects non-compliance, check for drift and auto-remediate if safe

when.description: Triggers when AWS Config compliance evaluation changes

then.description: First invoke DriftDetector, then chain to AutoRemediator

targets.comment: Stage 1: Detect if this is actual drift vs expected change

and_then.description: After drift detected, auto-remediate if severity allows

targets.comment: Stage 2: Fix the drift automatically or request manual approval

operational_principle.description: Config detects change -> DriftDetector validates drift -> AutoRemediator fixes or escalates
operational_principle.example: Someone manually changes security group -> Config detects -> Drift confirmed -> Auto-revert via Terraform

transparency.note: Every step logs to CloudWatch, so you can trace: Config event -> Drift detection -> Remediation action
transparency.audit_trail: CloudWatch Logs + EventBridge history = complete provenance
